 Print The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the final answer key for the Constable (GD) in Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs), Secretariat Security Force (SSF), and Rifleman (GD) in Assam Rifles Examination 2026. Candidates who appeared for the Computer-Based Test (CBT) can now access their final answer keys, question papers, response sheets and examination marks through the commission's official website, ssc.gov.in. The commission activated the download facility on November 3, 2026, at 5 PM. Candidates will be able to access the documents until November 17, 2026, at 5 PM. The facility requires candidates to log in using their examination roll number and password. The SSC has advised candidates to download and retain copies of their final answer keys and response sheets within the prescribed period. The documents will not remain accessible through the online facility after the deadline. SSC GD Final answer key 2026 : Steps to download
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the SSC GD final answer key 2026 on the official website: Visit the official website of the Staff Selection Commission at ssc.gov.in.
 Navigate to the relevant examination or answer key section on the homepage.
 Locate the notification or link for the Constable (GD) in CAPFs, SSF and Rifleman (GD) in Assam Rifles Examination 2026.
 Click on the final answer key and response sheet download link.
 Enter the required login credentials, including the examination roll number and password.
 Submit the details to access the candidate dashboard.
 Check the final answer key, question paper-cum-response sheet and marks displayed on the screen.
 Download the documents and take a printout for future reference.
 Alternatively, candidates can click on the link provided here to download the official notice related to the SSC GD final answer key 2026. Candidates are advised to stay tuned to the official website to get the complete details of the SSC GD examination 2026.
